Part payment can be made to supplier based on assessed value of stores delivered by supplier. Part payment for part delivery for only those items of BoQ shall be made, whose number in BoQ is more than one. In assessing the value of stor es delivered both the market rate and the rate derived from lumpsum rate quoted by supplier (Contractor profit factor shall be calculated as ratio of quoted rate and TS rate. Assessed cost of delivered items as per rate quoted shall be deemed as market rate x profit factor). The payment shall be made based on the lesser of the two cost t hus ascertained. Payment shall only be made of 85% of the ascertained/market cost of items delivered. In case of composite items like structure of shelter, no part paym ent shall be made. 35. Payment for Part Stores In Case of SO Cancellation. In case the se ller is not able to supply complete store, and the supply order cancelled, payment for part stores certified/CRAC generated shall be made in accordance of risk and expens e clause. 36. Risk Expense Clause. (a) Should the seller be unable to supply complete store within the delivery period, even after extension of 21 days has been given, the buyer shall be at fu ll liberty to cancel the supply order. To ascertain the market rates, t he buyer may ascertain rates by means of a Board of Officers or ascertain rate s or by floating tender for supply of balance items. Performance guarantee shall be forfeited in this case after 01 year of SO date. (c) Recoveries made on account of surplus amount required to procure part /whole of stores of cancelled supply order shall not exceed 25% of SO amount . 37. Force Majeure. Should any force majeure circumstance arise, buyer/ seller s hall be excused for non-fulfilment of contractual obligation, if the affected party, with in 5 days of its occurrence, inform other party in writing. Force Majeure shall mean fl oods, natural disasters for other acts, that are unanticipated or unforeseeable, and n ot brought about at the instance of the party claiming to be affected by such event,

or which, if anticipated or foreseeable, could not be avoided or provided for, and whi ch has caused the non-performance or delay in performance, such as war, turmoil, st rikes, sabotage, explosions, quarantine, restriction beyond the control of either party .
